topic: Weather backup plans on a multi-day route

content.hook: 50 km can mean totally different weather.

scenes.text: *50 km* can mean totally different weather.
Plan by segment. Set heat, wind and rain for *each one*.
Rough day ahead? Check how it changes your *riding days*.
Know your *bail-out spots*: lodging, shops, bike repair.
Pack for the conditions you *expect*, plus one layer spare.
Make your *plan B* before you roll.

content.question: Rain or heat: which one ruins your ride more?
content.caption:
Bikepacking weather backup plan: 50 km can feel like a different country.

A simple plan B for multi-day routes:
• Split the route into segments and think about weather for each one.
• Mark a bail-out spot in every segment: a town, lodging or a shop.
• Keep a buffer day, so one slow day doesn't wreck the whole trip.
• Check the forecast each evening, then adjust tomorrow.
• Pack one dry layer that stays dry no matter what.

Calm plan, flexible ride.
